notes.title: Fix for gloves turning permanently yellow
notes.notes:
A missing calibration menu, previously thought missing and assumed shy in making an appearance, has been found held captive and set free thanks to your help and feedback. A ruthless bug was found holding the poor menu captive and against it's will, but there's nothing a big stick and some fire can't fix.

[b]TLDR: Fixed various compatibility with various VR Headset models
[/b]
Thank you for helping us to improve our game!
